requirements_summary: Primary workloads: customer support chat (real-time), manuals/document search (embeddings), internal dev code-assistant
Baseline steady-state: 85 qps aggregate across chat endpoints; median output ~50 tokens
Peak forecast: 900 qps sustained during launch rehearsals (typical 20-30 minute windows); short spikes to 1,800 qps for <3 minutes
Latency SLOs: p50 target 35ms, p95 target 180ms, hard cap p99 < 800ms
Token/sec targets: steady-state ~42.5k tokens/sec output, peak token/sec up to ~540k tokens/sec
Model preferences: preference for high-quality open model 70B-class quantized int8; fallback 30B quantized for overflow
Quality requirement: maintain >=95% of baseline QA score on fallback for critical responses
Security: SSO/SAML, customer KMS integration, ISO27001 evidence required, audit logs retained 18 months
Network: VPC-peering and private model artifact registry; option for small air-gapped on-prem cluster for classified inference
workshop_findings: Traffic shape: weekday steady traffic with predictable peaks aligned to launch rehearsals and inter-department drills
Token distribution: 66% short (<40 tokens), 24% medium (40-160 tokens), 10% long (>160 tokens)
Batching tradeoff: 30-45ms batching reduces cost but worsens p95 during short high-frequency spikes; recommend hybrid path with fast-path bypass
Caching: document-level embeddings cache can reduce embedding QPS by ~15% on repeated manual lookups
Estimated GPU requirement: baseline capacity equivalent to 12x A100 GPUs with int8 kernels; scale to 36x A100-equivalent for sustained peak
Burst behavior: short spikes demand quick warm-up; pre-warmed burst pool recommended with 3-5 minute provisioning SLA
recommended_capacity: Reserved: 12x A100-equivalent GPUs in primary NA region to cover steady-state plus buffer
Autoscale headroom: policy to scale to 36x A100-equivalent for sustained peaks with pre-warm runbooks
Burst pool: contracted 10x GPUs available within 3 minutes for microbursts; metered minutes bucket with cap negotiated
Fallback models: primary 70B quantized for quality; automated routing to 30B quantized when queue depth > threshold
Caching & batching config: steady-state batching 35ms; enable TTL-based embeddings cache and fast-path for interactive low-latency calls
sla_negotiation_points: Latency SLA: p95 <= 180ms for chat when reserved pool active; SLA credits applied per calendar month for misses
Provisioning SLA: contracted burst GPUs delivered within 3 minutes for agreed minutes pool; pricing tiers for on-demand beyond pool
Availability SLA: 99.9% for dedicated pool with automated failover to on-prem cluster for classified workloads
Data residency & retention: explicit clause that PII-invoking requests processed only in specified regions or on-prem; audit logs export on request
Maintenance & change control: scheduled maintenance with 72-hour notice; emergency maintenance must trigger failover plan
procurement_notes: Finance requests monthly spend cap on burst minutes; asking for an alerting threshold and hard cap option
Legal to insert model artifact handling exhibit describing responsibilities for on-prem nodes
